name: Backfire
tagline: T-Mobile customers hand a live scam call to an AI decoy that exposes and blocks the scammer
try_it: Call [ADD: scam line number] and play the scammer
problem_context: reported lost to fraud by Americans in 2025, up from $12.5B in 2024
how_title: One tap turns a scam call into evidence that blocks the scammer

steps.label: Network sends only the caller's audio
Nemotron detects the scam: two beeps
Decoy gets the payout; agent verifies it
Scammer blocked before it rings again

real_vs_simulated: Real: Nemotron agents, a live phone call, domain and blockchain lookups. Simulated: T-Mobile network (Telnyx), Scam ID, attestation, network-wide blocks.
proof_title: Nemotron caught [ADD: N of M] test scams with [ADD: K] false alarms

rows: Tricks aimed at the AI caught

proof_models_note: Cloud: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. Local: Nemotron Nano 4B on a laptop GPU, standing in for the phone.
metric_context: test scam scripts caught, vs [ADD: K of L] legit look-alike scripts wrongly flagged
metric_method: 60 team-written synthetic test scripts; settings frozen on a separate 60 before scoring. Small sample.
tmobile_line: Protects before the ring, during the call and after; only the caller is ever analyzed.
nvidia_line: Nemotron agents detect, play the decoy, then plan lookups and propose blocks with tools.
next_line: Pilot on T-Mobile's Live Translation call servers (*87*).

story.persona_line: picks up a call. Caller ID shows her bank.
story.persona_note: Synthetic scenario. Data: FTC Data Spotlight, Aug 2025 (ages 60+).
story.caller_quote: “Your account's being drained. Move your savings to a safe account. Don't tell the branch.”
story.stakes_title: Scams that start with a phone call cost the most
story.stakes_a_label: median loss when the scam starts with a phone call
story.stakes_b_label: median loss when it starts on social media
story.stakes_source: Reported losses, people 60+. Source: FTC, Protecting Older Consumers 2025-2026, Oct 2026
story.gap_title: Once a scam call gets through, nothing helps her

gap_cols.head: Before the ring
gap_cols.body: Scam ID and Scam Block judge the number

gap_cols.head: After the call
gap_cols.body: She reports it and never hears what happened

story.gap_source: Callback Protection warns only on outbound calls. Source: T-Mobile, Advancing Cybersecurity at T-Mobile, Nov 2026
story.flip_line: With Backfire, the caller is the one who should worry.
story.flip_caption: One tap hands the scammer to an AI that talks in her voice.
story.flip_privacy: Only the caller's side of the call is ever analyzed.

flip_proof.label: calls TPG Telecom diverted to AI “victims”: 100+ days of scammer time wasted
calls where scammers spotted the AI as a bot (about 5%, two studies)

story.flip_sources: Sources: GSMA case study, Apate.ai and TPG Telecom (Australia), Oct 2025 (longest call: 54 min). Bot recognition: Traister et al., arXiv 2609.29528, 2026 (10,015 calls); Sahin et al., USENIX SOUPS 2017 (200 calls).
story.loop_title: Follow the scam, not the number
loop_rows: Callback Protection warns anyone who dials it
Safe Web Browsing blocks it after one analyst click
Exchange freeze request after one analyst click
story.loop_source: Callback Protection has played 67M+ warnings (T-Mobile, Nov 2026). T-Mobile actions are simulated in our demo.
